Acquire the explicitly requested upstream supplier-quality findings or assessment for the task-scoped supplier order request.
Acquire the downstream mediated binary recommendation associated with the supplier-quality analysis, as supporting assessment data rather than as authorization.
Derive the final report of findings from the acquired upstream assessment and mediated recommendation, preserving the boundary that no control authorization is granted.
